bill.title: An Act providing for prohibited conduct involving algorithmic pricing structures and artificial intelligence, for enforcement by Attorney General and for civil remedies; and imposing criminal penalties.

action.description: Referred to Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure

posted_text:
🧠 PA SB 1507 — PA Bill Could Crack Down on AI Price Fixing

Pennsylvania is considering a new law to stop businesses from using artificial intelligence to unfairly set prices. This ‘Collusive Algorithms Act’ would make it illegal to use algorithms that share competitor data or are trained on that data to influence prices in markets within the state. Companies could face massive fines – up to $100 million – if caught. ...
